title: Addition by Subtraction: Toward Mitigating Fragile Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06553v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) undergo safety alignment to prevent harmful generations, yet they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Recent work reveals a deeper structural weakness: safety alignment can be highly sparse, such that pruning a small number of safety-critical neurons or ablating a single refusal direction can substantially undermine aligned behavior. In this work, we take the first steps toward strengthening safety alignment such that it is less dependent on sparse model components. We propose Addition by Subtraction, which gradually removes identified safety-critical neurons during finetuning and uses preference optimization to re-establish safety-aligned behavior through other parts of the model. Our results show that the resulting models are substantially more robust to pruning-based attacks. Remarkably, these benefits generalize beyond the white-box attacks motivating our design: Addition by Subtraction improves robus

translated_title: 减法加成：迈向缓解大语言模型中脆弱的安全对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过安全对齐来防止生成有害内容，但它们仍然容易受到越狱攻击。近期研究揭示了一个更深层次的结构性弱点：安全对齐可能是高度稀疏的，以至于仅剪枝少量安全关键神经元或消融单一的拒绝方向，就能大幅破坏对齐后的行为。在这项工作中，我们迈出了强化安全对齐的第一步，使其不再过度依赖于稀疏的模型组件。我们提出Addition by Subtraction（减法加成）方法，该方法在微调过程中逐步移除已识别的安全关键神经元，并利用偏好优化通过模型的其他部分重新建立安全对齐行为。我们的结果表明，由此得到的模型对基于剪枝的攻击具有显著更强的鲁棒性。值得注意的是，这些收益超越了启发本设计的白盒攻击场景：Addition by Subtraction 提升了……的鲁棒性（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出Addition by Subtraction方法，通过在微调中逐步移除安全关键神经元并结合偏好优化，使安全对齐能力分散到模型的其他部分，从而缓解大语言模型安全对齐过度依赖稀疏组件的脆弱性问题，显著提升对剪枝等攻击的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Addition by Subtraction, which gradually removes safety-critical neurons during finetuning and uses preference optimization to re-establish safety-aligned behavior through other parts of the model, mitigating fragile sparse safety alignment and substantially improving robustness against pruning-based attacks.
